name: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Ltd.
summary: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited, an engineering company established in New Delhi in 1984, focuses on process and product innovation. Its products include thermostatic bimetal and trimetal strips, coils and springs, current sense shunts and resistors, EB welded products, presoldered strips and precision components, used in switchgear, relays, metering, automotive and battery management applications.
